subject.title: fix(infra): make exec-approvals lock ownership filesystem-safe

question: Which branch should be the single canonical landing candidate for the exec-approvals nonce-lock repair: the established proof-bearing PR or this current-main rebase?
rationale: Both open PRs present the same three-file implementation series, but the earlier branch carries the fuller live proof while this branch is explicitly rebased onto current main; choosing one determines where fresh validation and review should continue.

options.title: Retain the established PR
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111028 as the canonical review thread, rebase it if needed, and close this duplicate rebase once the exact current-head proof is attached.

options.title: Adopt this current-main rebase
options.body: Keep this branch only after maintainers verify equivalence with the established series and the contributor posts redacted current-head runtime proof, then close the earlier PR as superseded.

recommendation.title: Retain the established PR
recommendation.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111028 as the canonical review thread, rebase it if needed, and close this duplicate rebase once the exact current-head proof is attached.
